entries.zh: 节日；节期——西语并注“魔鬼之节”，指传教士眼中的中国民间节庆（神诞、鬼节之类）
entries.en: feast day, festival; glossed as the 'festival of the demons', the missionaries' term for Chinese folk feasts
entries.notes: 西语头词 la sua de diablos 的 sua 疑为缩写或古写（su），“魔鬼之节”一义的展开依赖推断。

entries.en: solar term (jieqi); season, division of the year

entries.zh: 中秋节；八月十五对月设节（R 栏注：因月亮而设此节）
entries.en: Mid-Autumn Festival; the feast kept at the (full) moon — R note reads 'que de luna háceme la fiesta'

entries.zh: 游玩、闲逛（“遊”字）；M 栏后两音节与 R 栏官话对音互不相合，余义存疑
entries.en: to stroll, roam for pleasure (遊); the last two syllables (cu poā / Mandarin hūy hoy) cannot be reconciled — partly uncertain
entries.notes: 头词 Pasarse 与“遊”字相合，但 cu poā 与 hūy hoy 两栏互不对应。

entries.zh: 游逛作乐（西语：游走嬉乐，虽只顾吃食亦然）；汉字栏作“儀”（礼仪）、音 cū gālã，与西语义不合，释义存疑
entries.en: to stroll and take one's pleasure alike, even if only over eating; Chinese column reads 儀 'rites' with cū gālã — incongruent, uncertain
entries.notes: 四栏互证失败：西语头词与“儀”及 cū gālã 对不上，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 行来行去；走来走去（ir y venir，来回走动）
entries.en: to go about, coming and going; to pace back and forth
entries.notes: 汉字栏第三字带[疑:來/表]，依 M 栏 lāy 从“來”字。

entries.zh: 闲行、闲逛——无事可做时的散步
entries.en: to stroll idly when there is nothing to do; to saunter about at leisure
to take a step; to walk about, move along
to travel all over the world; to journey everywhere
to be in all quarters; everywhere about the world

entries.zh: 行街；巡街（西语注：沿街游走，至公堂执法处）
entries.en: to walk the streets — headword adds 'pasear por las calles a la justicia', parading the streets to justice (patrolling or escorted to court)

entries.notes: 仅存西语头词 Passion/afection，汉字栏与两音栏全空，无从互证。

entries.zh: 轻；轻步——西语 paso/pasito（步、小步）与“輕”字对合，或谓脚步轻捷
entries.en: light; light of step (paso/pasito paired with 輕 'light')
entries.notes: paso~ 带缩写符号，西语义与“輕”字的对应依赖推断。

entries.en: lightly, softly, gently (輕仔, adverbial with -仔)

entries.notes: 疑为语法助词（partícula）条目，汉字栏空，M 之 buŷ 与 R 之 gy 互不相合，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 麻；麻木、肢体麻痹——西语 pasmo（痉挛、中风之类），又注为伤风受寒
entries.en: numbness, paralysis, spasm (pasmo); also a cold or chill (resfriado)

entries.notes: 头词 Parguiney 非标准西语、疑为汉字词之音写，di belos 不明，汉字栏带[疑:聯/聽]，无法定夺。
